messages:
maria: Quick check — planning to enable two runtime flags for a limited audience today: `runtime_flash_attn_v2` and `spec_decoding_opt1`. Goal: 1% of prod requests for 2h, then evaluate P50/P95 latency, token cost, and error rate. Anyone owning gate config or objections?
jonathan: +1 from runtime. Flash v2 has a small memory regression for tiny batches; spec-decoding needs a kv-cache fallback on mismatch. Ensure `kv_cache_prefetch` stays enabled for the canary.
li: Heads-up — model team saw logits drift for spec-decoding on long contexts (>8k). Prefer canary only for seq_len < 4096. Add a validation probe that samples long-ish traces.
maria: Good call. Proposed targeting snippet: 
```yaml
flag: runtime_flash_attn_v2
audience:
  - role: canary
    percent: 1
    constraints:
      - seq_len_lt: 4096
      - model_family: "redwood-small|redwood-medium"
```
maria: And for `spec_decoding_opt1` same audience but require `kv_cache_prefetch: true`.
ops-ryan: I can create the LaunchDarkly rules and pin them to the `canary_ops` set. Ops will monitor GPU OOMs and infra latency. I'll add auto-rollback if error_rate spikes >5% within 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rules created: runtime_flash_attn_v2 (1% seq<4096), spec_decoding_opt1 (1% seq<4096 + kv_cache). Watchers: @ops-ryan, @jonathan, @li. Runbook: /runbooks/runtime_toggle -> https://internal/runbooks/runtime_toggle
anya: I'll run a quick smoke test on dedup pipeline and run the eval minutes after enable. Can we add a request tag for canary: header `x-rw-canary: flashv2_spec1`?
jonathan: Yes — add header parsing and tag metrics. Add Datadog tag `rt.toggle=flashv2_spec1`. I'll create dashboards for latency and sample-quality (delta perplexity).
li: Also will replay 2k stored traces with seq_len 1k-6k to catch issues; if >0.5% token divergence we pause.
maria: Timeline: create LD rules now, enable at 18:00 UTC today, monitor for 2h, sync at 20:15 UTC. If green, expand to 5% with same constraints.
ops-ryan: I'm on-call at 18:00-20:30. If GPU mem >90% or p95 latency +20% I'll flip both flags off and notify #incidents :eyes:.
jonathan: PR for header and metrics tag: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5892 — small change, please review.
maria: @li can you run the QA harness and post a short summary here before 19:45? @anya attach smoke output.
li: Kicking off QA replay now; ETA ~25m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR CI passed, canary feature flag patch scheduled for prod. Note: toggle helper -> `scripts/ops/flag_toggle.sh runtime_flash_attn_v2 on --audience canary_ops`.
anya: smoke results (short): passed 10/10 sanity checks, no runtime errors. Log excerpt:
```
[18:06:12] trace=abc123 seq=512 latency=46ms tokens=124 divergence=0.0%
[18:06:14] trace=def456 seq=1024 latency=52ms tokens=256 divergence=0.02%
```
maria: Thanks. I'll enable flags at 18:00 and update thread.
ops-ryan: Toggled both flags to 1% at 18:00 UTC. Metrics tagged.
maria: Seeing initial metrics — p50 gen latency down ~5%, p95 stable, errors 0.01%. Good start. Keep eyes on infra.
li: QA replay halfway done, current divergence 0.08% token-level (still <0.5%).
maria: If divergence stays <0.5% and no infra alerts, expand to 5% at 19:15; otherwise rollback.
ops-ryan: Will hold expansion until explicit green.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Auto-rollback rule armed: error_rate>5% => disable flags. Not triggered.
jonathan: Post-runnote: add kv-cache hit-rate per canary tag to ensure spec-decoding doesn't thrash the cache.
maria: Agreed — pinging infra. I'll close after 20:15 check-in. Thanks all :thumbsup:
